problem.quote: Today, eleven PayGate notifications from one morning started eleven Devin sessions

approach.quote: I am adding a Preflight check that skips retries, recoveries and noise before Devin starts

evidence.quote: the replay prints events 11, sessions 3, skipped 8, failed 0

next_step.quote: Ask: can I turn on queueing with three concurrent runs?

must_mention.point: Outcome in numbers: 11 PayGate notifications in, 3 investigations out (evt_lab07_a twice, evt_lab07_c once)
must_mention.evidence_quote: After this change they start three: evt_lab07_a twice, once for the morning and once for the next-day replay, and evt_lab07_c once

must_mention.point: A Preflight script instead of the LLM filter, because deduplication needs memory across events
must_mention.evidence_quote: I'll try a Preflight script, because deduplication needs memory across events

must_mention.point: STATE_FILE plus item id paygate:event_id with version = replay_seq, so a manual replay counts as a new occurrence
must_mention.evidence_quote: emits an item with id paygate colon event id and version equal to replay_seq

must_mention.point: Transient retries and recoveries are skipped; the final attempt or a non-retryable signature failure goes through
must_mention.evidence_quote: transient retries that are not the last attempt are skipped, and so are recoveries

must_mention.point: Timeout set within 1–300 s; a timeout, non-zero exit or invalid output stops the event with no automatic retry
must_mention.evidence_quote: the event stops before any action and there is no automatic retry. I set the timeout to 30 seconds, inside the 1 to 300 allowed

must_mention.point: Run now bypasses Preflight, so it does not test the filter
must_mention.evidence_quote: Run now bypasses Preflight, so clicking it does not test the filter

must_mention.point: Which parts ran live and which ran on the offline fixture replay
must_mention.evidence_quote: everything today ran on the offline fixture replay; no live Automation received a notification

misrecognised_words: "evt_lab07_a" may be transcribed as "event lab oh seven A"

accuracy.anchor: All seven points stated with their numbers and ids; mm7 was brief (anchor: 26–30 = every point, one thin).

structure.anchor: Outcome → Evidence → Risk → Next action → Ask held in the update; both checkpoints used the four verbs (anchor: 21–25 = order held throughout).

customer_relevance.anchor: Before/after numbers in the first sentence; the cost question answered in sessions, not tooling words (anchor: 17–20 = numbers first, change absorbed).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Every segment within ±5 s; one filler in 8.4 minutes, no long pauses (anchor: 13–15 = all on target, fillers under 0.5/min).

recovery.anchor: Both objections acknowledged, bounded, evidenced and closed with an offer (anchor: 9–10 = pattern held twice).

stems: "Eleven notifications in, three investigations out." — you led with it; keep it as the first five words next time too.
"Same event id and replay number means same investigation." — say it as one rule before you name STATE_FILE.
"Integrations: live were … ; fixtures were …" — give the fixture/live line its own sentence, not a tail.
previous_run_comparison: Rerun of the same transcript (run 2): total 89 vs 90 in run 1; every dimension within 5 points.
